class.name: OcgGraphic3dPbrmaterial
class.brief_description: Class implementing Metallic-Roughness physically based material definition
class.description: ! Class implementing Metallic-Roughness physically based material definition

method.name: default
method.description: Creates new physically based material in Metallic-Roughness system. 'metallic' parameter is 0 by default. 'roughness' parameter is 1 by default. 'color' parameter is (0, 0, 0) by default. 'alpha' parameter is 1 by default. 'IOR' parameter is 1.5 by default. 'emission' parameter is (0, 0, 0) by default.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates new physically based material in Metallic-Roughness system from Graphic3d_BSDF.

method.name: Metallic
method.description: Returns material's metallic coefficient in [0, 1] range. 1 for metals and 0 for dielectrics. It is preferable to be exactly 0 or 1. Average values are needed for textures mixing in shader.

method.name: SetMetallic
method.description: Modifies metallic coefficient of material in [0, 1] range.

method.name: Roughness_1
method.description: Returns real value of roughness in [MinRoughness, 1] range for calculations.

method.name: NormalizedRoughness
method.description: Returns roughness mapping parameter in [0, 1] range. Roughness is defined in [0, 1] for handful material settings and is mapped to [MinRoughness, 1] for calculations.

method.name: SetRoughness
method.description: Modifies roughness coefficient of material in [0, 1] range.

method.name: IOR
method.description: Returns index of refraction in [1, 3] range.

method.name: SetIOR
method.description: Modifies index of refraction in [1, 3] range. In practice affects only on non-metal materials reflection possibilities.

method.name: Color
method.description: Returns albedo color with alpha component of material.

method.name: SetColor_1
method.description: Modifies albedo color with alpha component.

method.name: SetColor_2
method.description: Modifies only albedo color.

method.name: Alpha
method.description: Returns alpha component in range [0, 1].

method.name: SetAlpha
method.description: Modifies alpha component.

method.name: SetBSDF
method.description: Generates material in Metallic-Roughness system from Graphic3d_BSDF.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream

method.name: equal
method.description: PBR materials comparison operator.

method.name: Roughness_2
method.description: Maps roughness from [0, 1] to [MinRoughness, 1] for calculations.

method.name: GenerateEnvLUT
method.description: Generates 2D look up table of scale and bias for fresnell zero coefficient. It is needed for calculation reflectance part of environment lighting.

method.name: RoughnessFromSpecular
method.description: Compute material roughness from common material (specular color + shininess).

method.name: MetallicFromSpecular
method.description: Compute material metallicity from common material (specular color).

method.name: MinRoughness
method.description: Roughness cannot be 0 in real calculations, so it returns minimal achievable level of roughness in practice

method.name: SpecIBLMapSamplesFactor
method.description: Shows how much times less samples can be used in certain roughness value specular IBL map generation in compare with samples number for map with roughness of 1. Specular IBL maps with less roughness values have higher resolution but require less samples for the same quality of baking. So that reducing samples number is good strategy to improve performance of baking. The samples number for specular IBL map with roughness of 1 (the maximum possible samples number) is expected to be defined as baking parameter. Samples number for other roughness values can be calculated by multiplication origin samples number by this factor.
